Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo last week — HelixHealth is excited about Redwood's latency/cost story. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we generate a PO:

- PO must reference our Master Purchasing Agreement and include PO number in the invoice header.
- Payment terms: Standard request is Net 45.
- We need split invoices per cost center (we have 4 internal cost centers tied to this engagement). Each invoice must show the Helix project code and budget owner email.
- Invoice cadence: procurement prefers monthly invoices per cost center, but they will accept quarterly consolidated statements if the vendor provides a monthly cost breakdown.
- Required attachments: W9, SOW, and redlined MSAs if any.

Can Redwood accommodate Net 45 and split billing? Also please confirm where to send the PO and any vendor onboarding steps (portal or email).

Thanks,

Hey Sara / Evelyn — looping in pricing. A few clarifications on discounting and invoice cadence:

- Standard list is quoted in the deal. Switching to Net 45 increases our Days Sales Outstanding and cash exposure, so we typically apply a Net-45 surcharge. For this account we're prepared to offer a 1.5% effective discount off list (i.e., price reduction) in exchange for Net 45, or 2.0% if Helix agrees to a consolidated monthly statement (one monthly invoice per legal entity) plus separate CSV line-item exports for each cost center.
- If Helix requires separate invoices physically issued for each cost center (4 invoices monthly), we can do that but it reduces the discount to 1.25% due to increased bookkeeping overhead.
- We can accept PO references to our Master Agreement; please ensure the PO includes the billing address and tax id exactly as in W9.

Proposed invoice cadence options (choose one):
A) Monthly consolidated invoice + CSV cost-center breakdown (2.0% discount)
B) Monthly separate invoices per cost center (1.25% discount)
C) Quarterly consolidated invoice + monthly CSV breakdown (1.75% discount)

If you want early-pay terms (e.g., 10 days), we can discuss an additional early-pay discount (0.5%).

I'll prepare a pricing summary for RDW-2387 and a sample invoice format for your AP team.

—Marissa
